scenes.setting: Playing the great being in a reversed secret deed, The Fool questions the henchman's light-projection (visions only: Mr. Harras and his command-eyes, Belize cleaning a high-pressure steam rifle, cruel-smiled Ma'am Katy, Capim and Mr. Parker, Deputy Chief Vardera among guests abusing captive girls): at least four Beyonders, a Confinement seal on the basement, and the villa's layout
scenes.text_anchor: “What kind of powerful people are in Capim’s villa?”

scenes.setting: Back in the cheap hotel beside the unconscious henchman, plans are weighed: 'Perhaps, I don't need a helper… Picking the right time is very important.'
scenes.text_anchor: Perhaps, I don’t need a helper…

scenes.setting: East Borough, Zmanger territory: the possessed henchman picks a knife brawl with ferocious highlanders and takes a dagger to the artery — the kidnapper dies by 'his own' provocation, and the transparent figure inside him vanishes
scenes.text_anchor: It went right into his arteries.

scenes.setting: Checked out and homeward, then above the gray fog for one crucial line of ink: 'Capim's dinner time today.'
